validation.usernameChars: Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
validation.url: Enter a full URL like http://radarr:7878.
validation.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code or a recovery code.
validation.totpCodeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from your app.
validation.webhookUrl: Enter the full webhook URL, starting with http:// or https://.
validation.starrPasswordWrong: That isn't your Starr password. Try again.
validation.newServer: The URL points to another server: enter it again. Starr never sends the stored one to a new server.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.setupInvalidToken: That setup token isn't valid. Copy the current one from the container log.
errors.setupCompleted: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
errors.setupPublicUrl: Set STARR_PUBLIC_URL and restart Starr before finishing setup.
errors.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds and work once.
errors.loginExpired: The sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.

setup.title: Set up Starr
setup.description: Create the first admin account. You'll invite everyone else from inside.
setup.tokenHint: Printed in the container log when Starr starts without an admin.
setup.nextDescription: These steps wait in your Inbox, each with a link to where it's done.

invite.title: Join Starr
invite.description: Choose a username and password for your account.
invite.descriptionPreset: Your admin picked your username. Choose a password to finish.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account. This link works once.
setPassword.nextStep: Ask your admin for a new password link. Only the newest link works.

totpLogin.title: Two-step verification
totpLogin.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
totpLogin.hint: No phone? Use one of your recovery codes instead.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Starr doesn't send reset emails. Ask your admin for a reset link instead.
forgot.step1: Ask your admin for a new password link.
forgot.step2: Open the link they send you. It works once.
forgot.step3: Choose a new password there. Your old one keeps working until then.
